brief: Halde & Sons, a small coffee roaster, has a new single-origin out on Friday: Ethiopia Guji, washed, tasting of bergamot, peach and black tea. Make a 15 s 9:16 ad for Instagram Reels.
Railyard is a payments API: one API call moves money between bank accounts with instant settlement, and it sends a webhook at every state change. Make a 15 s 16:9 launch film.

Substation is a two-night techno festival in an old power station, 12-13 June. Make a 15 s 9:16 line-up announcement: Ancient Methods, Paula Temple, DVS1, Héctor Oaks, Rrose, Phase Fatale, Kia, Ida Engberg. Tickets Friday.
Burrow is a bedtime-story app for 3-7 year olds: parent and child make a new illustrated story together each night and the app reads it aloud. Make a 20 s 16:9 launch film for parents.

Make a 30 s 16:9 piece on Arctic sea ice: the September minimum, 1979 to now, from NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4 (https://noaadata.apps.nsidc.org/NOAA/G02135/north/monthly/data/N_09_extent_v4.0.csv). Cite the source.
Atelier Vauclair, an independent Swiss watchmaker, announces the Calibre 9: 38 mm steel, guilloché dial, 72-hour power reserve, 150 pieces. Make a 12 s 16:9 teaser.
Offset is a design-systems conference in Lisbon, 14-15 May 2027. Make the 15 s 16:9 opening titles that play before the first keynote.
Kestrel is an independent film distributor. Make its 6 s 16:9 logo ident, the one that plays before every film it releases.
Make a 30 s 16:9 explainer for a science channel: how noise-cancelling headphones cancel sound.

Make a 20 s 16:9 lyric video for the chorus of 'Low Tide', a song by the band Harbour Lights. Lyrics: "Hold me at low tide / when the harbour lights are gone / we were never meant to stay / but we stayed on". Write the music too.
Make the 10 s 16:9 broadcast opener for tonight's match: Northbridge City vs Harbour Athletic, Women's Super League, kick-off 19:45.
A contemporary art museum's new season is called 'Signal'. Make a 20 s 16:9 piece for the lobby screens, no words except the season name.
